highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: The firewall becomes the foothold: Attackers turn Check Point gateways against customers and Unocoin investigates potential exploitation of multisignature wallet backup mechanism. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Amazon Threat Intelligence observes threat actors running cybercrime campaigns with ARTEX AI agents. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Uber drivers impacted by data breach at third-party provider. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
